text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: feature_flag=route_policy_v2 -> 10% of traffic

carla-eng: rolled the flag at 15:04 UTC. canary id canary-2026-03-15-09

dave-support: seeing surge of 502/504 from customers, multiple tickets. :rotating_light:

dave-support: top complaint - timeouts on /v1/generate, some auth failures mentioned

ben_sre: looking at gateway metrics now, 5xx rate went 0.3% -> 6.2% after 15:05

alice.m: logs from gateway:
```
[2026-03-15T15:06:21Z] upstream reset while streaming, model_id=redwood/gpt-13b-v1, err=connection_closed
[2026-03-15T15:06:22Z] timeout waiting for kv-cache fill, route=policy_v2
```

frank-sre: quick hypothesis: new routing sends some customers to nodes without quantized kernels -> OOM or slow fallback -> timeouts

carla-eng: we changed `route_policy_v2` to prefer experimental pool `pool-experimental` for 10% traffic; that pool runs trimmed kernels. I didn't expect that mismatch.

erin-prod: @carla-eng can we flip the flag off for the canary immediately? or reduce to 0%.

carla-eng: initiating flag rollback now: `redwoodctl feature flip --name route_policy_v2 --value false --env prod --scope canary-2026-03-15-09`

deploy-bot: Flip scheduled: route_policy_v2=false requested by carla-eng at 15:09 UTC, applying to canary.

dave-support: repro steps from a customer (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-13b-v1","input":"hi"}' --max-time 30
```
They time out at ~20-25s or get 502.

ben_sre: I pushed a traffic split change to 0% for `canary-2026-03-15-09` -> verify metrics in 2m

alice.m: extracting a sample stacktrace from worker logs: `panic: unexpected kernel mismatch: expected q8_0, got f16` then worker restarts

frank-sre: that's consistent with kernel/quantization mismatch. Rollback should stop new hits but existing sessions might still fail until pools drain.

carla-eng: rollback applied. canary flags reverted at 15:12 UTC. now scaling down pool-experimental

ben_sre: p95 latency dropping, 5xx trending down to 0.6% after 3m

dave-support: pushing message to affected customers that we've identified a bad canary config and rolled back. ticket ids: #3451, #3452, #3457

erin-prod: action items:
- carla-eng to open follow-up ticket explaining why pool-experimental was targeted
- eng to add pre-rollout smoke check that hits representative model/kernel combos
- support to send customer updates
- SRE to create alert for feature-flip-induced 5xx spike

carla-eng: created ticket INF-7624 (postmortem & rollout gating). adding logs + reproduce steps

frank-sre: recommend we add a deploy gate: synthetic traffic + kernel compatibility matrix before any routing flag >0%

alice.m: confirm rollback fully finished; current 5xx 0.28% baseline, closing incident channel? :thumbsup:

ben_sre: I'll keep monitoring for 30m. leaving incident channel open until then.

dave-support: thanks team. will follow up with customers and close tickets after final ok.

deploy-bot: Incident marked resolved? no - monitoring window active

frank-sre: summary for postmortem: bad canary routing to experimental pool with kernel mismatch -> worker restarts -> gateway 502/504 & timeouts; rolled back flag; mitigations: gating, smoke tests, alerting

carla-eng: noted. PR coming to add gating and safer canary ramping config

alice.m: closing thread in 30m unless anything else
